purpose: Construct function selectors and reference-sharing cases inside an unprivileged child without importing candidate JavaScript into the trusted node:test process.

operations.inventory: Return bounded package metadata, declaration presence, export names, and process identity.
operations.is: Decode JSON-compatible nodes, selectors, position, parent, and context; reconstruct only allowlisted callbacks and shared references; invoke is once.
operations.convert: Construct one check from an allowlisted selector and invoke it over a bounded call sequence.

forbidden_boundary_values: accessors, custom prototypes, symbols, BigInts, cycles, and native objects
